name: features-accordion-media
title: Features Accordion Media
description: An accordion of features beside a preview panel that cross-fades to match the open row.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; title: string; description: ReactNode; media: ReactNode }[]
props.description: One row per feature. Exactly one row is open at a time.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Row open on first render. Defaults to the first one.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the preview takes to cross-fade.

props.name: title
props.description: Section headline. Labels the section for assistive tech.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
